UC01.title: Sign In / Out
UC01.description: Sign in, resume access and sign out

UC37.title: Allow App Notifications
UC37.description: Use the Enable notifications prompt or device notification settings. OneSignal registration is automatic background behavior, not a separate user-facing subscription screen.

UC39.title: Review Web Notifications
UC39.description: Review notifications and enable browser push

UC08.title: Complete First-Login Household Setup
UC08.description: First-login onboarding: select the eligible phone owner when required, confirm the household map location and address/apartment details, and optionally add a household photo. This does not publish alerts, report disaster safety or verify evacuation arrival.

UC12.title: View Evacuation Centers and Routes
UC12.description: View evacuation information and available directions

UC13A.title: Display Household QR for EvaTrack
UC13A.description: Display the household identity QR; EvaTrack is responsible for evacuation-arrival verification.

UC11.title: Assist a Trusted Household
UC11.description: Connect and assist a trusted household

UC23A.title: Publish Disaster Alerts Through OneSignal
UC23A.description: Declare a disaster and publish alert instructions

UC23B.title: Manage Active Event
UC23B.description: Review, update and close an active event

UC26A.title: Inspect Rescue Priorities
UC26A.description: Inspect rescue priorities and historical criteria

UC15.title: Review Assigned Rescue Mission
UC15.description: View own assigned incidents and households

UC26C.title: Approve Dispatch Completion
UC26C.description: Complete a dispatch through HQ approval

UC18.title: Record Rescue Member Assessment
UC18.description: Assess members of an assigned rescue household. Rescue check-ins are separate from EvaTrack evacuation-center arrival verification.

UC19.title: Submit Assigned Field Report If Needed
UC19.description: Submit a field report for the assigned household when applicable: record member conditions and property damage, review injury/death totals derived from member statuses, and optionally add notes.

UC27.title: Monitor Field Progress
UC27.description: Monitor field reports and team progress

UC16.title: Follow Assigned Rescue Route
UC16.description: Navigate and update assigned mission progress

UC17.title: Synchronize Saved Trips
UC17.description: Use saved navigation and synchronize trip events

UC20A.title: Transmit PTT Clips
UC20A.description: Communicate using internet PTT and clips

UC21B.title: Track Own Requests
UC21B.description: Track or cancel an eligible own request

UC32B.title: Validate Resource Requests
UC32B.description: Validate, return or complete a resource request

UC33.title: Forward Validated Requests
UC33.description: Forward a validated request and monitor fulfillment

UC28.title: Prepare Situation Reports
UC28.description: Prepare, save and export a situation report

UC30.title: Manage Archive Evidence
UC30.description: Browse, export and manage scoped archive evidence

UC34B.title: Authorize Report Release
UC34B.description: Decide report release and generate a signed file

UC35.title: Review Partner Reports
UC35.description: Request and review a partner report

UC40.title: Allow Device Location Access
UC40.description: Choose whether the app may access device location for household geotagging or assigned rescue navigation. Manual household map pinning remains available when GPS permission is declined.

UC41.title: Update Assigned Rescue Progress
UC41.description: Use the assigned mission controls to accept, mark en route, mark arrival and record household completion subject to the mission workflow; this is not HQ-wide dispatch approval.

excluded_use_cases.UC38: No SMS disaster-alert or user-facing SMS safety-submission feature is depicted.

scope_corrections.sms_scope: Configured account recovery only; never disaster-alert delivery.
